Aisha - CS: Team, Citrine Labs asked for a 3-day enablement sprint in two weeks. Focus: onboarding checklist, embeddings reliability, and dedicated migration prep. Renewal flagged at risk (orange). Need owners and quick agenda.
Diego - CSM: They prefer mornings UTC-7 and want a 90m workshop + 45m office hours each day. Also want an exec pulse on final day.
Mei - Enablement: I can run Day 1 (platform + quick deploy) and Day 3 (rollout + adoption). Need someone for Day 2 (embeddings & reliability).
Rory - SE: I can take Day 2 and include an "embedding regression" troubleshooting lab and a tiny diagnostics script.
Aisha - CS: Please add a 5-min renewal signal review on Day 3 to capture blockers and exec asks.
Mei - Enablement: Draft agenda:
Day 1 (90m): intro (15m) / auth & quick deploy demo (30m) / lab: run sample app (35m) / actions (10m)
Day 2 (90m): embeddings best practices (25m) / lab: embedding diagnostics + retries (45m) / cost & routing notes (10m) / actions (10m)
Day 3 (90m): dedicated/private patterns (30m) / migration dry-run lab (40m) / renewal pulse (5m) / exec sync (15m)
Schedule Bot: Tentative slots created: Mon-Wed 09:00-10:30 UTC-7 window (pending confirmation).
Rory - SE: Health-check snippet I'll post in the lab channel: curl to pull embedding error-rate and latency.
Diego - CSM: Timeline: finalize agenda by EOD Fri (1812350000), send invites Mon, pre-read 48h before Day 1. Presenters ack?
Mei - Enablement: ack :white_check_mark:
Rory - SE: ack :white_check_mark: I'll add the diagnostics gist and a short runbook.
Aisha - CS: I'll update renewal tracker and flag the account owner for exec invite. Let's capture all action items in the post-week CS thread. Thanks! :rocket:
